MEMORANDUM

TO: Office of the University Registrar; Council of Academic Deans
FROM: Office of Institutional Data & Governance
DATE: October 26, 2023
SUBJECT: Comprehensive Roster of Affiliated Academic Programs for Organizational Administration

1.0 Executive Summary

This document provides a definitive internal roster of academic programs associated with our university organization. Each strategic unit is cataloged with its official designation and corresponding registry identifier for administrative and communication clarity. The following profiles are to be considered the single source of truth for all inter-departmental correspondence and student information system management.

2.0 Academic Program Profiles

The academic program for Soils and Sustainable Land Systems (Registry ID: recgbn2VvmEBWmuUi) is a critical interdisciplinary unit. This program is instrumental in supporting the university's agricultural extension services and environmental policy research. The department's annual fall harvest festival is a popular campus event, though its planning is managed entirely by a student-led committee.

Regarding the vocational track for IT Support and Web Development, registered under identifier rec7SRmmw3oovHndK, this program maintains one of the highest post-graduation employment rates. Its curriculum is continuously updated to reflect current industry demands for cloud computing and cybersecurity specialists. We have received confirmation that the carpeting in the main computer lab is scheduled for deep cleaning over the winter break.

The program initially logged in the system as 'Financial Markets' has been corrected and finalized. The official designation is now Finance (Registry ID: rec0xRZtkzxrg8kj2), a change made to better encompass its broader focus on corporate and personal finance theory. This unit works closely with the university's endowment fund, providing students with unique hands-on portfolio management experience. The lead professor for the capstone course is also a nationally ranked chess player, a hobby he pursues in his personal time.

An administrative review of vocational certifications revealed a minor discrepancy in program naming. What was previously cataloged as 'Welding Arts' has been formally amended to Welding Technology (recr0WVEPZ08hl4Wt). This program is vital for regional workforce development, supplying skilled technicians to the manufacturing and construction sectors. Furthermore, the program's workshop recently had its primary ventilation system upgraded, a project completed two weeks ahead of schedule.

The unit for Animal, Dairy, and Veterinary Sciences (Registry ID: recIn8odwOmxEgrBl) serves as a cornerstone of the College of Agriculture. It consistently attracts high levels of federal research funding for its work in animal health and food production. The department’s break room coffee machine was recently replaced with a newer model that also dispenses hot water for tea.

We have a listing for the discipline of Philosophy (Registry ID: recGvuGMS6k5vjnst), which forms a core component of the humanities curriculum. The program fosters critical thinking and analytical skills applicable across a wide range of professions. Enrollment figures for its introductory courses have remained remarkably stable over the past five fiscal years.

The academic unit for Applied Economics (Registry ID: recFQ1RMc4EjTQFOi) is distinguished by its focus on econometric modeling and practical policy analysis. This program provides essential data-driven insights for both public and private sector partners. The department's administrative assistant has a noted collection of decorative succulents on their office windowsill.

A clerical error in the course catalog from the previous academic year listed the language program as 'Spanish Literature'. This has been rectified in the current master roster to the broader, more accurate title of Spanish (rec8TIqmun4d5vsvN). The program's immersion and study abroad components are consistently rated as highlights of the student experience. The department is also known for its vibrant participation in the campus-wide holiday decorating contest each December.

The program for Business (Registry ID: recxK3MHQFbR9J5uO) functions as a generalized pathway for students prior to their declaration of a more specific concentration. It provides a foundational understanding of market principles, management, and corporate ethics. Interestingly, the vending machines in the business school building were recently switched to a new vendor, resulting in a different selection of snack foods.

An update was required for the engineering school's roster; the program previously entered as 'Electrical Systems' is now correctly recorded as Electrical Engineering (rec7BxKpjJ7bNph3O). This strategic unit is heavily involved in robotics and renewable energy systems research, securing significant patents for the university. The department head is an avid birdwatcher and maintains a detailed log of campus avian life.

The program for Biochemistry (Registry ID: reckPDbeLc8ogfvWo) is a joint-effort discipline that bridges the biological and chemical sciences. Its research is fundamental to advancements in medicine and biotechnology. The primary lecture hall for this major, Henderson Hall Room 201, recently had its projector bulb replaced.

Initial registration data for the business college marked a program as 'Bookkeeping'. Following a curriculum audit, this has been updated to its formal, accredited title: Accounting (recuv3Nj4esENfIZW). This unit is essential for maintaining our AACSB accreditation and is known for its rigorous CPA examination preparation. The department's annual potluck is renowned for its diverse array of international dishes.

The unit for Music Therapy (Registry ID: recXNkQGvzEThZhG3) is a specialized health professions program that combines clinical practice with artistic skill. It has established partnerships with local hospitals and care facilities, providing students with invaluable practical experience. The department’s piano tuner is scheduled for their semi-annual visit next month.

A review of program names in the College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences noted a minor inconsistency. The program once labeled 'Food Systems' has been officially corrected to Food Science (rec6bKTSnOJAPwoXV). This discipline focuses on the chemistry, microbiology, and engineering of food production and safety. The department’s main laboratory recently passed its annual safety inspection with no citations.

The program for Dietetics (Registry ID: recd4JTuI0ssyoz07) is a professional track focused on nutrition and its impact on human health. Graduates are prepared for careers as registered dietitians in clinical and community settings. The department’s student association is organizing a campus-wide healthy bake sale next month to raise funds for charity.

We have the interdisciplinary program International Studies (Registry ID: recRA9IxLl6eKPsJX) on the roster. This unit combines political science, economics, and cultural studies to analyze global affairs. Its Model United Nations team has consistently performed well in national competitions for the last several years.

The program for Forest Ecology and Management (Registry ID: rec1N0upiVLy5esTO) is critical for training professionals in natural resource conservation and stewardship. This program leverages the university's extensive land holdings for field research and hands-on learning. The department's fleet of off-road vehicles recently underwent routine maintenance.

A minor correction was processed for the pre-law track; it was previously listed as 'Constitutional Law'. The official, broader designation is Law and Constitutional Studies (recxRBSgVYeSEGvyo). This program provides a strong foundation for students intending to pursue graduate studies in law or public policy. The department’s lounge is noted for having particularly comfortable armchairs, a frequent topic of student conversation.

The program for Landscape Architecture (Registry ID: recsiWnUNDT2kmOnr) blends artistic design with environmental science. Students in this major are responsible for several campus beautification projects, including the redesign of the main quad's botanical garden. The drafting studio for this program recently acquired three new large-format printers.

An audit of the health sciences college's offerings confirmed a naming convention update. The program formerly known as 'Community Health' is now officially designated as Public Health (recE5U2qZOYMmmnKZ). Its focus is on disease prevention and health education at the population level, a critical area of study. The building housing this department is slated for window washing on the first Monday of next month.

The unit for Global Communication (Registry ID: recFmin5MqRH5YC7m) examines how information and culture are exchanged across international borders. The curriculum includes media studies, rhetoric, and intercultural relations. The department’s newsletter, "The Global Gazette," is published bi-weekly and has a small but dedicated readership.

We have the specialized education program Physics Teaching (Registry ID: recVYIFAwjT91pnv7) on record. This unit prepares students for state licensure to teach physics at the secondary school level. It combines rigorous subject matter expertise with pedagogical training.

The program for Management Information Systems (Registry ID: recdem96jNnpiXfsH) is located at the intersection of business and technology. This unit trains students to design and manage the data systems that support modern organizations. The department’s student chapter of the Association for Information Systems is one of the most active on campus.

majors = re.findall(major_pattern, content)

# Create a dictionary mapping ID to major
